items.followUp: What is the difference between a client-server network model and a peer-to-peer network model?

rubric.why: Checks that the answer defines what a network model describes.
rubric.description: Defines a computer network model as a way of describing communication between computers or devices on a network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it describes how networked computers or devices communicate.

rubric.why: Checks a key purpose of communication on a computer network.
rubric.description: Mentions that networked computers can share resources.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the model relates to sharing resources over the network.

modelAnswer: A computer network model describes how computers or devices communicate and share resources over a network.

items.followUp: What is the purpose of the <body> tag in an HTML document?

rubric.why: Checks the role of the html element in the document structure.
rubric.description: Identifies the <html> tag as the root element or as enclosing the HTML document.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that it contains or encloses the HTML document.

rubric.why: Checks that the opening and closing tags mark the document boundaries.
rubric.description: Explains that the opening <html> tag marks the document's start and the closing </html> tag marks its end.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating the start and end functions of the tags.

modelAnswer: The <html> tag is the root element of an HTML document.
The opening <html> tag marks the start of the document, and the closing </html> tag marks its end.

items.followUp: How can the “Act it Out” strategy help in solving a problem?

rubric.why: Checks the basic meaning of the strategy.
rubric.description: States that Act it Out involves physically performing or simulating the actions in a problem.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing the actions as physically performed or simulated.

rubric.why: Checks the purpose of using the strategy.
rubric.description: Explains that acting out the actions helps understand the problem or find its sequence or solution.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating a relevant purpose or benefit.

modelAnswer: “Act it Out” is a problem-solving strategy in which the actions or steps of a problem are physically performed or simulated.
This helps make the process easier to understand and can help find the correct sequence or solution.
